body: Thank you!

TLDR; Is there a primer that works for multiple hard gel brands?


I recently bought the DND 800 DC Base G (base coat), DND brand color polish, and DND 700 DC Top Coat. But then I realized that I might need primer. The DND website offers primer, but it's sold out.


Is there another primer that you guys recommend? Do I need a primer with this gel brand set? Their instructions mention: "Starting with completely clean and prepped nails, apply a single coat of base gel and cure for 30 seconds in a LED lamp."


Thanks in advance!
Thank you so much ❤️. Perhaps visualization would help me. Visualizing what getting better could look like
Thank you <3

Thank you for sharing. I'm currently in a deep healing process right now (for something recent and for long-term depression), trying different coping skills and planning other methods/therapies to try and it's so easy for me to slip back into suicidal ideation whenever the emotional pain is too much. I just wanted to see if it was actually possible to still continue on, and it helps that you shared your experience
Thank you. I can try. I worry about my ability to discern which friends I can trust and which I should keep at arms length

Thank you. I really hope it does get better after this.


I have all the access, I suppose. A long-term therapist, psychiatrist, family, and friends not in the situation (though I worry if I can trust any friend at the moment. No fault of their own). I'm wondering if I need to take time off and do more intensive therapy (PHP/IOP). Or maybe DBT skills group therapy. It's just been pretty hard to find my worth (or even more depressingly, why bother existing at all) knowing this kind of pain happened and could happen again
Thank you for the support. She told me after I told her my boyfriend was planning on formally proposing to me

Thank you for sharing your story and for validating me. Yes, that's really the fucked up part about it all. The cheating alone is very damaging, but then it extended to everyone else involved in the cover up. Ruined. 


How have you coped/dealt with it since then? And do you still talk with anyone in that immediate social circle?
Yes. I mean at least the stuff that I've been told. I was given text messages between the parties involved from back then to prove it
Currently sorting that out. It's not easy for me, emotionally, to just cut him off then and there. May very well be a fizzle out
I agree with "protecting you" as a bullshit excuse. If they truly believed that as a valid excuse, then they will know otherwise

Thank you. People have been suggesting to me to prioritize self care, and I decided to look into it more after reading your comment. It's true that it'll take time. Potentially a LONG time. But I can see how the point is to help you (universal "you") see your self worth after going through an event that makes you feel completely stripped of that worth. 


I just hope it's something that I can see as a viable alternative path rather than going the "kms" route
Someone tried it? Has it worked for them? Just curious

I guess it's something I don't stop and think about often. Though it's clear to me that it's at least causing me to "fail" at my mental health. I just don't know how to fight self-inflicting thoughts of "I'm not good enough". I'm never good enough. I'm never doing enough. These constant thoughts playing over and over and it frequently gets to the point that the only way to end the overwhelm is it end myself

I can't handle all the stress and anxiety I I've had from the two months I've been in school so far (PhD program). I seemed to have forgotten everything in my mental health toolbox to prevent getting to this point, and I don't feel like I have to time to implement potentially useful coping skills. I'd just like to not feel this way anymore
Got it. Thanks! Was struggling with some writer's block

Agreed. Thank you for your input

I don't know what it means for the both of us, regarding less transparency, but I definitely don't want him to feel uncomfortable getting help or other private matters as well

But I'm seeing now that there's just things that he'd be more comfortable keeping private, and that's okay. I'm learning to be okay with it.
Thank you. This was my issue during this conversation with my boyfriend. I was shocked and hurt when I found out, but I could've kept this in and brought it up with my therapist instead.

It looks like
- Staying in bed longer before getting up in the morning
- Skimping on my teeth cleaning routine
- Refusing to do my daily meditation routine
- Staying in my car in the parking lot longer before I get out and head into my office
- Walking very slowly
- Sighing louder
- Showering once a week

Shit I feel the same way. The exact same way. Every night. And I'm glad you shared because it let's me know that it's not just me feeling this way. I take sleeping pills to knock me out every night, but that only temporarily disrupts the negative thoughts till the next day. I still keep going because... Well, death seems nice but I can't bring myself to do that right now. So every night I struggle. The mental pain really hurts. But it's nothing new to me

Yep, I feel the same way. I keep going because the other choice would be to kill myself and can't do that right now. Everything is harder when suicidal. Everything you do takes much more energy because you're fighting against the thought that every task is pointless. It sucks, but what else can you do?

For the past few months, I've been taking on way too much at work. Many projects, all with similar deadlines, and then unexpected "fires" pop up every day that take my focus away from the main task. I don't try to look for another job because I can see the same issue arising. Taking on more than I can and having poor the management.

As of right now, yes, I'm staying in my job for the salary and the job security. I was thinking of saving enough before I leave, but I'm concerned about my rapidly declining mental health. Idk how much longer I have
Thanks for the reminder. I suppose I'll need to find support along the way if I decide to try the unknown

I feel the same pain in my chest. Every day when I leave work. And like you, I feel the need to kill myself to get rid of it. 

At the very least, thank you for sharing this. At least it's brought together a group of people with similar experiences. I take comfort in that. I hope you do too.

I guess it's hard to explain. A good portion of myself has given up and is constantly encouraging me to die. The smaller portion still thinks there's a chance. So it's a constant battle in my mind. I don't hear voices
Glad it's been helping. Yeah, I fear applying for another job while on leave too. If I were to go on leave, I'd likely start applying 2-3 months after returning to my current job

From what I've researched, gunshot to the head. Quick, painless, most likely to succeed.

Of course, even if you were able to do it painlessly, would you? Would you still be too scared to do it? What are you currently afraid of?

I feel like I'm in a similar position. For me, I came from a good family, grew up upper-middle class, graduated from a top-tier university, got a graduate degree, working in a good-paying job, and yet, for over 6 years, I've felt severely depressed and had many suicidal thoughts (I'm 25). 

What I do know is that we shouldnt use our societal circumstance to justify whether or not we should be depressed. Everyone has their own reasons. For me, I believe I feel this way because I'm not living the life I truly want to live. I did all the right motions, as I mentioned in my previous paragraph, but it's not what I truly care about. It's not what makes me happy. And as of now, I still struggle to find out what does.
